note: Newer gated campground (keypad entrance) in timber on Hwy 17, a quarter mile north of the Buck Hollow access on the Jacks Fork; the river is not on the property. RV sites are a row of angled pull-ins along a gravel drive; also cabins, glamping tents and primitive tent camping, with a concrete shower house, a covered pavilion, a riding arena and horse stalls. Long-term stays are also sold on the RV sites. --Claude
summary: Confirmed from the operator's pages: 10 full-hookup 30/50A RV sites at $40/night, shower house, dump station, Starlink wifi, Firefly booking; now also sells long-term stays at $400/month. Under the $50 gate at the posted rate. Not waterfront confirmed: the river is the Jacks Fork, about 800 m south. Google 4.9 over 48. Phone and website match.
flags: WATERFRONT (stands, not waterfront): the 'river' is the Jacks Fork (Buck Hollow access, Ozark National Scenic Riverways). On the 2600 m frame the nearest bend is about 800 m south of the RV row, across a forested ridge and Hwy 17; nothing on the property touches water. The operator says the same: 'situated on 17 highway 1/4 of a mile north of the Jacks Fork Buck Hollow River Access', and a guest review on the site 'river access is just down the road'.

ENGINE QUOTE NOT RUN: the Firefly priced search sits behind a reCAPTCHA and the helper notes say not to automate it; only the kiosk landing page was read. The $40 is the operator's posted rate; engine fees and tax are unknown. A saved page from the owner would settle it.

LONG-STAY CHECK: the park now advertises 'Now Offering Long Term Camping' on the RV sites at $400/month, with only 10 RV sites in all. Nightly booking is still sold online and the posted nightly rate is first on the amenities list; the leaf-off imagery frame (undated) shows the RV row empty. If the ten sites fill with monthly tenants this becomes a drop candidate under the long-stay rule - worth a re-look next pass. How many of the ten are monthly is not published.
